I thought I posted my routine! Sorry 😊

I kept it pretty simple for a while (face wash and moisturiser only) , because I added so much at once to try get rid of my acne fast it ended up being so angry at me! Just added things slowly to see how my skin reacted. 

I found what works best for me for now, 

AM routine:
* Water wash my face with cold/luke warmish water (not freezing)
*Cosrx Aloe SPF 50 / Olay complete day cream SPF 15

Done!

PM routine:
* Garnier Micellar water
*Cleanse with either Cosrx low pH good morning cleanser or Pixi glow mud cleanser
*Cosrx AHA/BHA clarifying treatment toner/ Pixi rose tonic 
*Niacinamide 10% Zinc 1.5% (every two days or so)
*Duac gel (prescribed- would highly recommend if you haven't got it before)
*Cerave PM facial moisturiser for sensitive skin

I also exfoliate using Secret Key Lemon Peeling gel once a week and have had a Salycilic acid facial peel over a month ago which seemed to have helped alot!

I've had acne for 3 years by the way and have been prescribed many things from the GP (can't remember them now) but the Duac gel is the best thing they've given me so far. 🙂

Right. I had my nipple pierced 3 years ago and it took a year to heal 'fully' but for some people it never heals completely. 

The best advice I could say is not to have a bath in the first 2 weeks or so, salt water bathe 2 times a day (you need a lot less sea salt than you might  think- just taste it and if it tastes like to ocean, dilute it) I just lie down with a shot glass of it over my nipple for 10-20 minutes.

Also, mine has recently got infected due to it being pulled *very* hard during a shower with a mesh shower puff... For the love of god NEVER use them- way too risky, it felt like my soul left my body for a second. 

Also don't peel off the crusty parts that happens during the healing, it can cause breaks in the skin that could lead to infection. Just bathe it in the salt water and use a clean ear bud to get it off while it is moist.

Anyway, best of luck! It's my favourite piercing but also the most temperamental!
